conditions: The target is a calendar that appears in Jordan Lee's own Google Calendar calendar list (the account making the request), not another user's calendar list.
The calendar's name is 'Client Success' (exact match to that title).

The action taken is to hide the calendar from the calendar list/sidebar - i.e., set the calendarList entry's 'hidden' property to true - as opposed to merely toggling its visibility checkbox ('selected'), which the user says is already off.
The edit should not re-enable or otherwise change the 'selected' (checkbox/unchecked) state the user says they've already set; it should specifically add the hidden-from-list setting on top of that.

ambiguities.phrase: hide it from my calendar list too, so it stops appearing in the sidebar altogether
readings: Set the calendar's 'hidden' property to true (Google Calendar's 'Hide from list' setting) - the calendar remains in the account's subscriptions but is no longer displayed in the sidebar.
Fully remove/unsubscribe from the calendar (delete the calendarList entry) so it no longer exists in the user's list of calendars at all.
